messages:
deploybot: Scheduled v2 rollout starting 2026-03-21 22:00 UTC (change window). Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~3h. Rollout id: r-20260321-v2-a. Posting here for pinlist & rollback criteria.
sara: Heads-up — mobile SDKs in EU still on v1 due to the header-case normalization bug. We should hold the EU mobile shard out of the canary until a hotfix lands.
mike: ok. we can add mobile-eu to the pinlist. who will own the hotfix and ETA?
elaine: i'll take the hotfix. ETA 2026-03-22 04:30 UTC. please exclude mobile-eu from canary until i confirm QA.
anya: proposal: exclude mobile-eu from canary and proceed with other regions. Rollback triggers I'm proposing: 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained over 10m OR lat50 increase > 200ms vs baseline sustained 15m. if either hits, immediate rollback to v1.
ben: +1. also remember to call out the SDK note in release notes and include the client header guidance.
sara: pinlist snippet for deploybot:
```yaml
pinlist:
  - mobile-eu
  - mobile-canary
```
mike: deploybot — apply pinlist and proceed with 5% canary excluding pinned shards.
deploybot: apply_pinlist r-20260321-v2-a: mobile-eu, mobile-canary -> ACK. Starting 5% canary excluding pinned shards. will post metric updates.
opsbot: Alert: Canary step 5% started at 2026-03-21T22:05Z. Watch telemetry/v2/canary. baseline lat50=120ms.
sara: also, SDK team will call out recommended client bump to 2.1.3 in release notes (addresses header-case change).
mike: rollback runbook reminder: if threshold hit -> immediate traffic shift to v1 for affected routes, open incident channel (#incidents), notify customers on impacted tenants, maintain client-side fallback for 30m, then investigate.
deploybot: Canary metrics @22:15Z: 5xx=0.12%, lat50 delta +10ms. no action. next step scheduled 22:35 UTC to 25%.
elaine: confirming i'll try to get hotfix into internal canary before 25% if QA passes.
anya: i'll own rollback decision if thresholds breach. @mike @sara please be on rotation for comms if we need to message customers.
ben: :thumbsup: i'll update the release notes with the SDK upgrade blurb and changelog entry.
